payout_quote: To receive the $100 Refer-A-Friend bonus, 1) an existing CSB consumer client refers a new client to open a consumer checking account (subject to approval), 2) the new referred consumer checking account must be open a minimum of 90 calendar days and cannot have a previously closed CSB consumer checking account within the past 12 months, and 3) the new client's account must have a balance greater than zero at the end of business on the 90th calendar day. Existing clients can earn unlimited Refer-A-Friend bonuses.
steps: Be an existing Community State Bank (BankCSB) consumer client
Refer a new client to open a consumer checking account (subject to approval)
The new account stays open a minimum of 90 calendar days with no previously closed CSB checking within the past 12 months
The new account has a balance greater than zero at end of business on day 90
You earn a $100 bonus credited to your account within 30 calendar days after the 90-day qualifying period
catches: No stated cap: ‘Existing clients can earn unlimited Refer-A-Friend bonuses’
90-day waiting period: friend's account must stay open 90 calendar days with a balance > $0 on day 90
Friend must not have closed a CSB consumer checking account within the past 12 months
Bonus credited within 30 calendar days after the qualifying period; both accounts must be open at payment time
Iowa residents only; cannot be combined with other offers; this is an ongoing offer subject to change without notice
All bonuses reported to the IRS; you are responsible for applicable taxes
biggest_catch: $100 per referral with no cap — but your friend's account must stay open 90 days with money in it, and it's Iowa-only.
eligibility: Existing Community State Bank consumer clients; referred friends must be new-to-CSB (no closed CSB checking in 12 months), Iowa residents
timing: 90-day qualifying period, then bonus credited within 30 calendar days
